title: California law requires AI tools to embed digital fingerprints in synthetic media
description: California's AI transparency law took effect Aug. 2, requiring large generative AI providers to embed hidden provenance data in synthetic media and offer free detection tools. Violations carry a $5,000 penalty per day of noncompliance.

title: CBP AI Flags Transshipped Goods Before Customs Clears Them, Closing Post-Audit Loophole
description: CBP AI transshipment detection takes a new form with Detective Border, which scores shipments before customs clears them. The White House report names 40-plus countries at elevated risk, estimates $19B-$34B in annual lost tariff revenue, and pairs the AI system with Executive Order 14411's retroactive penalty authority.
